purpose: Progressive FireOpsSim company training tracks. These are training aids, not certification or official department records.

tracks.title: Fire Attack
tracks.description: Progress from attack-line fundamentals to coordinated multi-company fire attack.

stages.title: Attack Line Fundamentals
stages.goal: Build a repeatable stretch, water call, nozzle check and advancement process.
stages.advanceWhen: Crew completes two consistent repetitions without instructor step-by-step prompting.

stages.title: Flow & Hose Management
stages.goal: Connect hose management and stream quality to delivered fire flow.
stages.advanceWhen: Crew recognizes and corrects introduced flow restrictions while maintaining communication.

stages.title: Flow Path & Door Control
stages.goal: Integrate suppression timing with door/ventilation decisions.
stages.advanceWhen: Crew explains and coordinates actions based on changing fire conditions.

stages.title: Coordinated Interior Attack
stages.goal: Combine line selection, stretch, entry, advancement, communications and changing conditions.
stages.advanceWhen: Crew completes the scenario safely while adapting to at least one inject.

stages.title: Coordinated Attack
stages.goal: Coordinate suppression, search and ventilation as one incident plan.
stages.advanceWhen: Companies communicate and sequence actions without conflicting tactical effects.

stages.title: Fire Attack Performance Evaluation
stages.goal: Evaluate retained decision-making and crew performance without coaching during the evolution.
stages.advanceWhen: Evaluator documents locally defined performance criteria; official completion belongs in the department's approved record system.

tracks.title: Search & Rescue
tracks.description: Build from orientation and known-victim search to coordinated search under changing conditions.

stages.title: Orientation & Crew Integrity
stages.goal: Establish a systematic search and reliable orientation method.
stages.advanceWhen: Crew searches a simple area while maintaining orientation and integrity.

stages.title: Known Victim Search
stages.goal: Choose entry and removal paths using victim information and conditions.
stages.advanceWhen: Crew completes the search and can explain entry, isolation and removal decisions.

stages.title: Changing Conditions Search
stages.goal: Adapt search actions when suppression progress or conditions change.
stages.advanceWhen: Crew recognizes the change and modifies the plan rather than following a memorized sequence.

stages.title: Search + Suppression Coordination
stages.goal: Coordinate search decisions with a separate suppression assignment.
stages.advanceWhen: Search and suppression exchange operationally useful information and avoid conflicting actions.

stages.title: Search Performance Evaluation
stages.goal: Evaluate retained search decision-making with minimal coaching.
stages.advanceWhen: Evaluator documents locally defined criteria; official completion remains outside FireOpsSim.

tracks.title: Firefighter Survival & Mayday
tracks.description: Develop SCBA problem recognition, Mayday communication and rescue-team coordination.

stages.title: SCBA Emergency Procedures
stages.goal: Recognize equipment/air problems and use department/manufacturer-approved responses.
stages.advanceWhen: Member identifies and communicates simulated problems without unsafe improvisation.

stages.title: Mayday Recognition
stages.goal: Recognize locally defined Mayday triggers and transmit early.
stages.advanceWhen: Member initiates the local Mayday procedure without instructor prompting.

stages.title: Mayday Under Radio Load
stages.goal: Maintain intelligible communications and radio discipline under controlled workload.
stages.advanceWhen: Critical messages remain understandable and member follows local radio procedure.

stages.title: RIT/RIC Deployment
stages.goal: Coordinate rescue-team deployment, communications and removal decisions.
stages.advanceWhen: Team follows local deployment procedure and adapts to scenario information.

stages.title: Firefighter Emergency Evaluation
stages.goal: Evaluate integrated recognition, communications and rescue-team actions.
stages.advanceWhen: Evaluator documents local criteria without unsafe stress or uncontrolled entrapment.

tracks.title: Driver / Operator
tracks.description: Progress from apparatus positioning and pump fundamentals to changing water-supply problems.

stages.title: Apparatus Placement
stages.goal: Position apparatus for tactical function, access and later-arriving resources.
stages.advanceWhen: Operator explains placement decisions and identifies conflicts/hazards.

stages.title: Tank-to-Supply Transition
stages.goal: Transition from tank water to sustained supply while maintaining assigned flow.
stages.advanceWhen: Transition is repeatable and follows local apparatus procedure.

stages.title: Supply Complications
stages.goal: Recognize and respond to controlled supply restrictions or changing demand.
stages.advanceWhen: Operator identifies the problem and communicates corrective action.

stages.title: Multi-Line Pump Operation
stages.goal: Manage changing line demand while maintaining water-supply awareness.
stages.advanceWhen: Operator maintains situational awareness and stays within equipment/local training limits.

stages.title: Driver / Operator Evaluation
stages.goal: Evaluate retained placement, supply and pump decision-making.
stages.advanceWhen: Evaluator documents department-defined performance; use FireOps Calc for supplemental hydraulics practice.

tracks.title: Company Officer / Command
tracks.description: Develop size-up, initial command, resource coordination and adaptive decision-making.

stages.title: First-Due Size-Up
stages.goal: Convert observable arrival information into a concise report and priorities.
stages.advanceWhen: Officer consistently communicates useful facts and identifies the highest-priority problem.

stages.title: Initial Action Plan
stages.goal: Match assignments to staffing, conditions and available resources.
stages.advanceWhen: Assignments are clear, achievable and adjusted when information changes.

stages.title: Changing Conditions
stages.goal: Recognize tactical triggers and revise the incident plan.
stages.advanceWhen: Officer changes strategy/tactics when scenario conditions warrant it.

stages.title: Coordinated Attack Command
stages.goal: Coordinate suppression, search, ventilation and incoming resources.
stages.advanceWhen: Assignments support one incident plan and conflicting actions are identified early.

stages.title: Company Officer Evaluation
stages.goal: Evaluate retained command decision-making with scenario injects and minimal coaching.
stages.advanceWhen: Evaluator documents local command-performance criteria.

tracks.title: Truck / Tools / Ladders
tracks.description: Progress from tool and ladder decisions to integrated access and aerial positioning problems.

stages.title: Ground Ladder Selection
stages.goal: Select, raise and place ladders based on the tactical objective.
stages.advanceWhen: Crew repeatedly selects and places the appropriate ladder while identifying hazards.

stages.title: Forcible Entry Decisions
stages.goal: Size up access problems and choose appropriate tools/techniques.
stages.advanceWhen: Crew explains construction clues, tool choice and backup plan.

stages.title: Access + Ladder Coordination
stages.goal: Coordinate access, secondary egress and ladder objectives under staffing limits.
stages.advanceWhen: Crew prioritizes tasks and communicates a workable plan.

stages.title: Aerial Positioning
stages.goal: Choose aerial placement based on objective, access, scrub area and hazards.
stages.advanceWhen: Crew can explain tradeoffs and identify positioning conflicts.

stages.title: Truck Operations Evaluation
stages.goal: Evaluate retained truck-company decision-making across tools, access and placement.
stages.advanceWhen: Evaluator documents local performance criteria.
